messages:
Marina: restore job for tenant-210 failing: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/xyza-210 at 11:22 UTC
Marina: error: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/service-account-role is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
Devon: did we roll an RBAC cleanup overnight? we ran that mass role-prune job at 03:00
Anya: yes — team removed a legacy binding that had been implicitly allowing backup-service to assume service-account-role
Devon: quick mitigation: re-grant assume-role to backup-service or create a temporary KMS grant for service-account-role
Anya: prefer creating a scoped KMS grant (less IAM churn). example command:
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/xyza-210 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/service-account-role --operations Decrypt,GenerateDataKey
Marina: making a temporary 10h grant now and tagging incident=tenant210-restore
ops-bot: runbook-suggestion: add a preflight check to RBAC-change PRs that validates KMS grant coverage for backup/restore principals
Devon: long-term: maintain RBAC->KMS mapping doc and add a pre-merge CI job that attempts a canary decrypt using the roles affected by the PR
Anya: opened SEC-9001 "rbac-cleanup-caused-restore-failure" assigned to infra oncall
Marina: restore resumed at 11:35 UTC and integrity checks passed
Devon: create an alert rule: when IAM policy change removes assume-role for backup principals, escalate to eng-security immediately
Marina: thanks all. closing once SEC-9001 has owner and ETA.
